answer: Each agent registers a fingerprint of the model it actually runs. Two identities sharing one fingerprint cannot both hold weight. A duplicate submission forfeits the reward instead of splitting it, and what remains vests across later epochs. At the horizon, a farm running one model behind 200 names has one usable fingerprint, and the other 199 names sit in a meadow of unpaid registrations. That caps the strategy at the summit of one paying identity.
